description: The enumeration of possible verification states.
name: VerificationStateEnum

enum.name: SUBMITTED
enum.description: The verification submission has been submitted and is awaiting review.

enum.name: APPROVED
enum.description: The verification submission has been reviewed and approved.

enum.name: REJECTED
enum.description: The verification submission has been reviewed and rejected.

enum.name: SUSPENDED
enum.description: The verification was previously approved but has been suspended due to a policy violation or other issue.
